name: validate_proposal
title: Validate Trial Result selections
description: Submit one selection per Trial, with candidate, explicit relation, scope_rationale, population_rationale, source_passages, unknowns and counterevidence together. No separate assessment or evidence-basis list is required. Use candidate=null and source-grounded missing_facts only when no complete comparative candidate can proceed. Unknown scope facts about an existing candidate belong in unknowns, not another Trial selection. Compare outcome definition, reported model window, estimand and population separately; numeric correspondence does not establish exactness. Preserve the target window and distinguish eligibility from analysis exclusions or missing observations. Enrollment eligibility alone does not narrow an all-randomized target in this Trial; external generalizability is separate. Candidate estimate/precision are source strings. Group values require group_id, value and unit; statistic is optional and unresolved when omitted. Timing value/unit must be supplied together. Exact requires all eight clarity facets explicitly specified; do not infer clarity. Design-specific evidence remains explicit. Narrative/figure handles go in source_passages; candidate.evidence is only for advanced typed proofs. The server derives record tags, source identity and duplicate canonical citations, not scientific correctness. Construct the complete typed request before calling; do not submit placeholders or partial nested objects. Save with the returned revision; the server retains the validated draft.

selections.description: One candidate or grounded missing selection with reasoning per Trial.

items.description:
One Trial's choice, source citations and scientific reasoning together.

The public request does not mirror separate canonical Result and reasoning
records. Conversion duplicates the caller's explicit claims, never infers
a scientific relation, missing fact, design or source meaning.

trial_id.description: Server-issued Trial ID for this single selection.

relation.description: Explicit relation to the target. Exact, broader, narrower, component or related requires a candidate; ambiguous or unavailable requires candidate=null and source-grounded missing facts. Never infer exactness from numbers.

anyOf.description: One source-reported candidate and the interpreted target facets.
Host's explicit account of which requested and reported Result facets are known.

outcome_definition.description: Whether the requested and reported outcome definition is established.

measurement.description: Whether the requested and reported measurement is established.

time_point.description: Whether the requested and reported time point or window, including any material data-cut chronology, is established.

analysis_population.description: Whether the requested and reported analysis population is established.

comparison_groups.description: Whether the requested and reported comparison groups are established.

effect_measure.description: Whether the requested and reported effect measure is established.

source_table_meaning.description: Whether source-reported values and table cells have a clear meaning, including whether the selected estimate and precision are consistent across the relevant source material.

eligible_result_choice.description: Whether the chosen reported result is established as the target candidate.

clarity.description: Caller-declared scope facets; omission preserves unclear facets and cannot establish exactness.

design.description: Source-supported randomization design; not inferred from the effect estimate.

design_rationale.description: Why inspected source evidence establishes this design.

design_evidence.description: Selected handles specifically supporting design, distinct from general selection citations.

target_measurement.description: Requested measurement or ascertainment, not a summary statistic.

target_time_value.description: Target time quantity when explicitly quantified; pair with target_time_unit.

target_time_unit.description: Target time unit paired with target_time_value.

comparison_groups.description: Complete target randomized-arm identifiers and assignments.

id.description: Caller-owned structural identifier used to reference this comparison group.

assignment.description: Source-supported description of the intervention assigned to this group.

baseline_subgroup.description: Baseline-defined target subgroup, or null for all randomized participants in this Trial; enrollment eligibility alone does not narrow that Trial target.

intended_effect_measure.description: Target effect measure, which can differ from the selected reported measure.

reported_outcome.description: Literal endpoint label from this candidate's quantitative source anchor; put interpreted equivalence or separately sourced endpoint criteria in scope_rationale.

reported_definition.description: Source-tied definition including reported model window and population when supported; do not borrow the target window.

analysis_population.description: Source-supported participants and exclusions in the reported analysis; ITT is not complete observation.

effect_measure.description: Source-reported comparative effect measure; supply together with estimate.

estimate.description: Source-reported estimate string, not a numeric object.

precision.description: Optional verbatim source interval expression for this estimate, preserving confidence level and units when stated; interpreted meaning belongs in scope_rationale.

group_values.description: Complete paired source values when no comparative estimate is reported; optional alongside an estimate.

group_id.description: Structural reference to a target comparison-group id; it must match a target id but does not require a separate Source Evidence mapping.

statistic.description: Source statistic label when identified. Omission or null preserves unresolved meaning; the server does not infer a label.

unit.description: Source-reported unit for this group value.

category_group_id.description: Descriptive profile group; one-arm descriptions cannot proceed to comparative assessment.

category_denominator.description: Source-reported denominator basis for a category profile.

category_axis_names.description: Explicit category dimensions in the source profile.

categories.description: Complete source-reported category cells; never infer omitted cells.

items.description:
One complete source-located cell in a categorical result profile.

A one-arm profile records only the supported randomized arm. Comparator
categories must never be invented to satisfy a comparative shape.

The source cell is copied as one opaque value. Do not invent a statistic
or unit label that the selected material does not contain.

category_axes.description: Ordered complete non-treatment row, column, or series labels locating one table cell.

evidence.description: Optional table/derived quantitative proof only. Use selection.source_passages for narrative/figure handles.

kind.description: Structured evidence from one selected table.

handle.description: Selected table passage handle copied from this Trial.

basis.description: Whether the selected table material is text or visual.

title.description: Exact or normalization-equivalent title copied from selected table material.

scope.description: Exact or normalization-equivalent scope copied from selected table material.

cohort.description: Exact or normalization-equivalent cohort label copied from selected table material.

row.description: Exact or normalization-equivalent row label copied from selected table material.

columns.description: Complete ordered column labels copied exactly or normalization-equivalently from selected table material.

group_or_category_axes.description: Complete ordered category or series labels copied exactly or normalization-equivalently from selected table material; preserve every applicable dimension.

cells.description: Reported cell labels or values copied exactly or normalization-equivalently from selected table material.

units.description: Exact or normalization-equivalent units copied from selected table material.

denominators.description: Exact or normalization-equivalent denominators copied from selected table material.

footnotes.description: Applicable footnotes copied exactly or normalization-equivalently from selected table material.

kind.description: Structured evidence assembled from separate table fragments.

basis.description: Multi-span table evidence uses selected text.

spans.description: Selected fragments and the table role each fragment supports.

role.description: The part of the table represented by this selected fragment.

handle.description: Selected table-fragment handle copied from this Trial.

title.description: Exact or normalized table title or definition.

scope.description: Exact or normalized scope represented by the table.

row.description: Exact or normalized quantitative row label.

group_or_category_axes.description: Complete ordered category or series labels.

kind.description: A calculation over selected source values.

operation.description: The operation used to derive the reported value.

inputs.description: Selected source values used by the calculation.

handle.description: Selected source-value handle copied from this Trial.

value.description: Source value used in the calculation.
Calculated value with units when applicable.

candidate.description: One complete comparative candidate, or null only when no complete candidate can proceed.

scope_rationale.description: Why this candidate supports the chosen relation and time window, or why captured missing facts prevent a complete candidate.

population_rationale.description: For a candidate, distinguish baseline eligibility from analysis exclusions and missing observations.

source_passages.description: Inspected same-Trial passage handles supporting the selection and reasoning. The server reuses these citations in Result and reasoning records; it does not certify entailment. Use [] only for a captured zero-source intake condition.

missing_facts.description: Grounded missing inputs, only when candidate is null; candidate uncertainties go in unknowns.

items.description: Caller-owned missing input and its typed basis.

fact.description: Specific missing fact required to define a Result.

basis.description: Typed source or intake basis that establishes this missing fact.

oneOf.description: Caller-owned Evidence premise before the server copies its exact source.

kind.description: Use when selected Evidence explicitly establishes missing reporting.

evidence.description: Selected Evidence handle that establishes the missing fact.

oneOf.description: Caller reference to the captured no-supported-Sources intake condition.

kind.description: Use only for a captured intake condition.

code.description: Captured condition showing that the Trial has no supported Sources.

unknowns.description: Material unresolved facts about this selection; explicitly use []. Unknowns about an existing candidate are not another selection.

counterevidence.description: Source-bound counterclaims and implications; explicitly use [] when none are identified.

evidence.description: Same-Trial Evidence handle for this counterpoint.

implication.description: How this conflicting Evidence limits or challenges the assessment.

ResultScopeReview.description: Read-only comparison of represented scope; not an entailment judgment.

instruction.default: Compare outcome definition, time window, estimand and population against the selected source passages. Null reported timing/estimand means not separately represented, not absent from the source. Known target fields, a matching endpoint label, or bound numbers do not prove exactness. Keep material conflict/uncertainty in clarity and rationale; choose a supported non-exact relation or another candidate when exact scope is not established. Do not redefine the target.
